PublicApplicabilityConditions.description: OR alternatives of AND necessary conditions. Missing conditions are unknown. Source report identity/revision/URL and text hash bind the extraction; hosted service does not observe the target. Even all listed conditions met does not prove exploitation.

identity_assurance.description: The coordinate and public identity are supplied by the caller; matching an advisory or registry listing does not verify an installed artifact.

source_fixed_versions.description: Explicit source patch versions and OSV fixed events only, across branches. Empty can mean absent historical metadata or a source null; it does not prove no fix exists. This union is not an upgrade recommendation.
